limitations: rain_soft: The requested gentle, thunder-free quality remains unverified; the name describes the documented umbrella-rain source instead.
crickets: Field cricket recording supplied; nocturnal recording conditions were not established. The display name deliberately does not claim nighttime.
notes: Eight distinct new source recordings; none of the eight excluded existing recordings were reused. No synthetic substitutions.
No manifest, Dart/JS source, shared test, configuration, or existing audio asset was modified. This JSON fragment is for the main agent to merge.
All outputs: 30-45 seconds, mono PCM16 at native 44.1/48 kHz, two-second equal-power overlap and rotated seam. No whole-clip fade was added.

rain_soft uses the middle 24 seconds of a 31.2375-second source to avoid low-level ends. Its 22-second loop is repeated twice for a 44-second WAV; this is disclosed repetition, not 44 seconds of unique recording.
For peak-heavy sources only, isolated peaks above 0.60 are smoothly limited toward 0.72 so background RMS remains audible. All affected sample counts are recorded.
Source full-scale samples are recorded separately; zero output clipping does not certify that the original field recording was free of distortion.
All eight public WAV sources downloaded completely with HTTP 200 via curl. Python urllib received HTTP 403; curl succeeded. No login, payment, software installation, or upload was used.
Source pages and WAVs are kept only in the OS temporary working directory. Exact page and download SHA-256 hashes, authors, licenses, and descriptions are retained in each entry.

Listening tests and browser audition were not performed. Names and descriptions follow visible publisher metadata; thunder absence, nighttime conditions, and subjective sleep suitability are not independently verified.
